title: Why Linux is making a comeback on desktop in 2026

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know Linux is now powering 15% of all desktops in 2026?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It's not just for devs anymore — it's becoming mainstream.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Linux is an open-source operating system that's faster and more secure.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: With Wayland and improved app support, it's finally user-friendly.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Students, creatives, and even big companies are switching en masse.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Linux is here to stay — and it's getting better every day.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how you can try it? Drop a comment below!
